description: This file is a test suite for Sass mixins related to utility class generation. It uses Sass's @include, @mixin, and @content features to define and test various utility class generation functionalities, including different property values, states, CSS variables, RTL support, and responsive (rfs) behavior.

methods.name: test-generate-utility
methods.description: A mixin that wraps the generate-utility mixin with assertions to verify generated utility classes based on provided parameters.
